raw_response:
This is my main plot for beans, but it is only 0.15 hectares and I must save my money for my family's needs. Beans do not need so much nitrogen because they fix it from the air, and I have some manure from my goats and chickens to spread on the soil to keep it fertile. My wife and children will help me prepare the land, weed, and harvest with our hoes, so we do not need to hire anyone, and the rains in Morogoro are usually enough without irrigation.
